title: Artifacts Beta Release
description: Released Artifacts feature in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, allowing users to turn session output into live, shareable pages on claude.ai that update in place as the session works.

community_feedback.quote: As a vibe coding skeptic, I was amazed. It has a learning curve. You need to learn how to give good instructions
The April postmortem didn't fix everything, and the token inflation makes it worse
Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks

title: Trusted Devices for Remote Control
description: Added Trusted Devices feature for Remote Control Admins on Team and Enterprise plans to verify devices before remote Claude Code sessions.

title: Claude Tag for Slack Integration
description: Team and Enterprise plans can now tag Claude directly in Slack conversations and delegate tasks while focusing on other work.

title: Transition to Usage-Based Billing
description: GitHub Copilot moved from flat-rate/request-based billing to usage-based billing using GitHub AI Credits. All plans now charge based on actual token consumption depending on the model used. Copilot code review now consumes GitHub Actions minutes.

community_feedback.quote: Usage-based billing makes Copilot harder to trust as a daily development tool
The change made Copilot unusable for individual devs
Unfair and unclear pricing model that penalizes casual, honest users

title: Acquired by Cursor - Final v2.0.0 Release
description: Continue.dev was acquired by Cursor in June 2026. Version 2.0.0 (June 19) is the final release of the open-source VS Code extension, CLI, and JetBrains plugin. The GitHub repository is now read-only.

community_feedback.quote: Woke up to an email saying continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor
Why the Cursor Acquisition Should Concern Every Software Developer
The value of Cursor depends on trust. Developers let it see architecture decisions, private code, and now they're acquiring competitors

title: SDK Updates: Custom Tools, Stores, and Auto-Review
description: Major SDK update including TypeScript and Python support for custom storage solutions, new custom tools capabilities, automated code review mode, nested sub-agents support, and enhanced reliability with run correlation IDs.

title: v0.45.0 Release - Performance and Terminal Improvements
description: Released v0.45.0 with safer auto-updates, improved terminal and WSL handling, faster and more reliable core behavior, and new user actions.

community_feedback.quote: Among multiple CLI agents in my project, the only one causing problems is Gemini
So I've tried Gemini CLI... Now I get it why it's not very popular

title: Service Changes and Traffic Prioritization
description: Google announced changes to Gemini CLI service affecting how traffic is routed, with priority given to accounts based on certain criteria. Access restrictions and 403 ToS errors reported by users.

community_feedback.quote: Plans to make gemini cli good

title: Remote Feature General Availability
description: Codex Remote reached general availability for connected Mac systems. Connections established since June 8, 2026 will remain. Added per-host personality settings.

title: Platform Updates and Bug Fixes
description: June 26 update brought Archive/Unarchive functionality, language selection for AI-generated review comments, and various bug fixes and performance improvements across the platform.

title: Market Position Update in June 2026
description: Aider maintains v0.86.2 as stable release (February 2026) with continued active development. Recognized as best open-source CLI coding agent with 41.6k+ GitHub stars, git-first approach, and backend-agnostic flexibility supporting any LLM including local models.

community_feedback.quote: Aider writes 70-80% of its own code in each release
